title: Crossfunc alignment 1:1 + weekly prep (Product / Eng / Applied ML)
content:
Meeting: Cross-functional roadmap sync (prep + notes)
Owner: Eli Navarro (notes/scratchpad)
Intended audience: Product PMs, Eng leads, Applied ML reps (informal)
Date of next sync: 2026-03-15 weekly sync; 1:1 prep for Ravi on 2026-03-13

Purpose / framing:
- Quick alignment on Q2 roadmap trade-offs where Applied ML work is a gating factor for hosted features.
- Identify any scope pulls / deferrals that would materially change capacity planning for Dedicated.
- Make a decision on the rollout order for the latency-optimized vs accuracy-optimized model variants.

Desired outcomes for the sync:
- Agree on final milestone dates for: model onboarding + quantization trials, API contract changes, and rollout gating checklist.
- Assign owners for each dependency and create clear acceptance criteria.
- Capture immediate action items (<= 2 week horizon).

Attendees I plan to call out / message ahead:
- Zoe Chen (Product — hosted API) — lead on API contract and migration plan
- Ravi Patel (Eng — serving runtime) — capacity and kernel selection / perf targets
- Noah Kim (Applied ML) — model quantization + evals owner
- Optional: Lina (SRE) for canary rollout ops checklist

Prep notes / talking points by function:
- Product (Zoe):
  * Current ask: expose 2 new query params for mode selection (accuracy|latency) + deprecation timeline for legacy param.
  * Concern: migration pain for customers using custom batching — need SDK compatibility notes.
  * Acceptance criteria suggestion: SDKs updated + docs + 1 production integration test before canary.

- Eng — Serving runtime (Ravi):
  * Perf target: p95 <= 220ms on gen-4 sequence distribution; if quantized model chosen expect +10–30% throughput improvement.
  * Constraint: we have 2 dedicated GPU pools reserved in April — need final memory footprint 2 weeks prior.
  * Risk: KV cache invalidation across model-variant routing may add tail latency spikes; propose a mitigation plan (staggered cache warm-ups).

- Applied ML (Noah):
  * Plan: run quantization sweep on two candidate models (v2-large, v2-medium) — provide evaluation on instrinsic QA and hallucination metrics by 2026-03-20.
  * Data needs: 5 representative prompt sets from Product (Zoe) — request by 2026-03-12.
  * Open question: is the accuracy delta acceptable at 4-bit quant with our safety filters? Need to define an SLA for hallucination rate.

Key decisions to push for in sync:
- Choose rollout order: (A) latency-first variant then accuracy fallback OR (B) accuracy-first then latency optimization.
- Acceptable regression threshold: max 3% relative F1 drop on targeted eval set (proposal).
- Canary cadence: 3-stage (internal -> limited customer beta -> general) with rollback triggers defined by error rate + latency shift.

Dependencies / blockers (short list):
- UX/Docs: SDK PR to be ready by 2026-03-18 (owner: Zoe) — blocker for canary start.
- Infra: Dedicated pool memory reservation confirmation (owner: Ravi) — need by 2026-03-22.
- Data: curated prompt sets from Product for evals (owner: Zoe) — need by 2026-03-12.
- Eval infra: automated regression harness support for quantized models (owner: Noah) — ETA 2026-03-20.
- Legal/compliance: no new PII exposure expected but double-check telemetry for debug logs (owner: Lina SRE / legal check).

Proposed milestone draft (for discussion):
- 2026-03-12: Product delivers prompt sets + priority feature list (action: Zoe).
- 2026-03-18: SDK compatibility PR open + docs draft (action: Zoe).
- 2026-03-20: Quantization sweep complete; evaluation report (Noah).
- 2026-03-22: Infra reservation confirmed; memory footprint locked (Ravi).
- 2026-03-25: Canary stage 1 (internal) begin if above met — evaluate rollback triggers.

Acceptance criteria (candidate):
- Functional: API contract stable with backward-compatible flags + SDK tests pass.
- Perf: p95 latency within target for chosen variant on dedicated pool.
- Quality: regression on primary eval set <= 3% relative drop; hallucination incidents below agreed threshold.
- Ops: monitoring + tracing hooks in place; rollback plan tested in staging.

Risk matrix (quick):
- High: Quantization causes subtle failure modes in long-tail prompts (mitigation: expanded eval including long-form prompts).
- Medium: KV cache invalidation increases tail latency (mitigation: staged cache warming + telemetry).
- Low: SDK migration friction (mitigation: cherrypick compatibility shims + migration guide).

Immediate action items (post-1:1 / pre-sync) — owners + dates:
- Zoe: send curated prompt sets to Noah and label priority examples (due 2026-03-12).
- Ravi: confirm Dedicated pool reservation and share approximate alloc plan (due 2026-03-15).
- Noah: spin up quantization sweep infra and smoke run on small subset (due 2026-03-16).
- Eli (me): prepare short decision slide (1 slide) summarizing trade-offs and recommended rollout order (due 2026-03-13).
- Lina (SRE): quick checklist for canary monitoring + rollback triggers; share minimal alerting config (due 2026-03-18).

Follow-ups to capture in meeting notes:
- If Product cannot provide prompt sets on time, propose we proceed with synthetic prompts + increase post-canary monitoring window to 2 weeks.
- If quantization regressions exceed threshold, fallback plan: ship accuracy-optimized variant first and schedule a focused quantization sprint for May.

Notes to self (scratch):
- Keep the sync tight: 30–40 minutes max. Use slides to force decision, not debate.
- Start 1:1 with Ravi to surface any infra surprises; don't let perf discussion drift into micro-optimizations.
- Emphasize customer impact when we talk about acceptance thresholds — tie to specific customer flows (search, draft assist).
- Remember to ask Noah about evaluation noise: how stable are runs across seeds? Good to know before committing to a 3% threshold.

Possible questions to ask during sync:
- To Noah: what is the worst-case long-tail delta you've seen in prior quantization runs?
- To Ravi: can we provision an isolated GPU pool that mirrors production for a 48h soak test?
- To Zoe: which customers should we invite to the limited beta? prioritize by integration complexity, not revenue.

Clipboard for post-meeting quick email (draft):
- Subject: Notes + actions — Crossfunc roadmap sync (date)
- Body bullet points: who attended, decisions made, owners and due dates (copy from action items above), link to canary checklist + eval report when available.

Open flagged items for follow-up research (personal):
- Check prior quantization PRs for flaky eval cases (search repo: quant-eval/2025).
- Pull telemetry samples for request distributions to validate p95 target realism.

Misc one-liners I want to remember:
- "If rollback is easy, we can be aggressive; if rollback is hard, be conservative."
- Prioritize measurable checkpoints over abstract guarantees (concrete gates win).

---
End of scratchpad. Update after 1:1 with Ravi and then before weekly sync on 2026-03-15.
